title: 第19章 组建班底，万亿帝国的入场券-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》
content:
第(1/3)页

    下午三点。

    门铃响起。

    林川走过去开门。

    叶知秋站在门外。今天换了一身黑色职业套装，白色真丝衬衫的扣子系到锁骨下方，剪裁极好。

    干练中带着恰到好处的锋利感。手里拎着一个黑色公文包。

    “进来吧。”林川侧了侧身。

    叶知秋换上拖鞋，走进客厅。

    “林先生，这是九州创投的实缴流程文件。”

    她走到茶几前，将几份文件整齐摆开，

    “注册资本一千万，实缴账户已经跟银行那边对接好了，最快明天上午到账。验资报告我也提前联系了会计师事务所，走加急通道，两个工作日内出。”

    汇报的节奏干净利落，没有一个多余的字。

    林川光着脚踩在地毯上，走到单人沙发前坐下，指了指对面的位置。

    “坐。”

    叶知秋坐下，背脊挺直，双手交叠在膝盖上。

    林川没有看那些文件。

    他靠在沙发靠背上，目光落在叶知秋身上，打量了她两秒。

    “这几天辛苦你了。”

    叶知秋微微一愣。

    这句话从林川嘴里说出来，语气太自然了。

    不像客户对服务人员的客套，倒像是一个老板在跟自己人说话。

    “应该的。”叶知秋回了一句。

    林川没接这个话茬。他换了个姿势，手臂搭在沙发扶手上。

    “你在国信干几年了？”

    “四年。”

    “一个月给你开多少钱？”

    叶知秋没想到他会问这个。

    “底薪加提成，好的时候差不多一万五到两万。”她如实回答。

    这个年代的深圳，这已经算得上金字塔中上层的收入了。

    养活自己绰绰有余，比大部分同龄人都过得体面。

    林川点了点头，表情里没有任何评价。

    “你有没有想过，换个地方？”

    客厅里安静下来。只剩中央空调的低频嗡鸣。

    叶知秋看着林川的眼睛。那双眼睛此刻没有压迫感，甚至带着点笑意。但她后背微微绷紧了。

    她太聪明了。林川话才开了个头，她已经猜到后半句。

    “林先生的意思是……”

    “我接下来需要有人帮我做事。”林川身体微微前倾，双手十指交叉搁在膝盖上。

    “资金调度，公司运营，对外联络，包括一些不方便我亲自出面的事情。我身边需要一个助理。”

    他顿了一下。

    “不是那种端茶倒水的秘书。”

    叶知秋没有说话。

    “这几天你帮我办的事，我都看在眼里。”林川的语气里带着点欣赏。

    “注册公司，你一天搞定。筛选楼盘，你把每套房子的采光时长和周边业主背景都摸了一遍。证券账户三千万的资金调度，你处理得滴水不漏。”

    “说实话，你的能力待在国信那个营业部，浪费了。”

    叶知秋的手指微微蜷了一下。

    浪费。

    不是没有想过。四年了，从普通客户经理做到高级经理，一步一步往上爬。

    但这条路的天花板她看得清清楚楚——营业部总经理，一年三十万顶天了。然后呢？

    没有然后。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Three o'clock in the afternoon.

The doorbell rang.

Lin Chuan walked over and opened the door.

Ye Zhiqiu stood outside the door.Today I changed into a black professional suit. The buttons of the white silk shirt were tied to the bottom of the collarbone. The cut was excellent.

It is capable and has just the right sharpness.He was carrying a black briefcase in his hand.

"Come in." Lin Chuan turned sideways.

Ye Zhiqiu put on slippers and walked into the living room.

"Mr. Lin, this is the actual payment process document of Jiuzhou Venture Capital."

She walked to the coffee table and laid out several documents neatly.

"The registered capital is 10 million, and the paid-in account has been connected with the bank. The account will arrive as soon as tomorrow morning. I also contacted the accounting firm in advance for the capital verification report and took the expedited channel. It will be issued within two working days."

The rhythm of the report is clean and neat, without a single redundant word.

Lin Chuan stepped on the carpet with his bare feet, walked to the single sofa and sat down, pointing to the seat opposite.

"Sit."

Ye Zhiqiu sat down, with his back straight and his hands folded on his knees.

Lin Chuan did not read those documents.

He leaned on the back of the sofa, his eyes fell on Ye Zhiqiu, and he looked at her for two seconds.

“I’ve worked hard on you these past few days.”

Ye Zhiqiu was slightly startled.

This sentence came out of Lin Chuan's mouth, and his tone was so natural.

It’s not like a customer being polite to a service staff, but like a boss talking to his own people.

"It should be." Ye Zhiqiu replied.

Lin Chuan didn’t answer the question.He changed his position and put his arm on the arm of the sofa.

"How many years have you been working at Guoxin?"

"Four years."

"How much does it cost you per month?"

Ye Zhiqiu didn't expect that he would ask this.

“Basic salary plus commission, on good days it’s almost 15,000 to 20,000.” She answered truthfully.

In Shenzhen in this era, this can already be regarded as the income of the middle and upper levels of the pyramid.

It’s more than enough to support myself, and I live a decent life than most of my peers.

Lin Chuan nodded, without any comment on his expression.

"Have you ever thought about changing places?"

The living room became quiet.All that's left is the low-frequency hum of the central air conditioner.

Ye Zhiqiu looked into Lin Chuan's eyes.Those eyes were not oppressive at the moment, and even contained a smile.But her back tensed slightly.

She is so smart.Lin Chuan had just started talking, and she had already guessed the second half of the sentence.

"Mr. Lin means..."

"I need someone to help me with things next." Lin Chuan leaned forward slightly, crossing his hands and resting them on his knees.

"Fund allocation, company operations, external liaison, including some things that are not convenient for me to appear in person. I need an assistant by my side."

He paused.

“I’m not the kind of secretary who serves tea and pours water.”

Ye Zhiqiu said nothing.

“I’ve noticed all the things you’ve done for me these days.” Lin Chuan’s tone was filled with appreciation.

"Registering a company, you can do it in one day. When screening real estate, you have checked the lighting hours of each house and the background of the surrounding owners. You have managed the 30 million yuan fund allocation in the securities account without leakage."

"To be honest, your ability is wasted in Guoxin's sales department."

Ye Zhiqiu’s fingers curled up slightly.

waste.

It’s not that I haven’t thought about it.In four years, I have climbed up step by step from an ordinary account manager to a senior manager.

But she could clearly see the ceiling of this road - the general manager of the sales department could earn up to 300,000 yuan a year.Then what?

There is no then.
